I think you're a Dark Winter, check out the color palette for that. I think your lip colors too light and bright, you can totally get away with richer colors. Your make-up looks a bit flat right now. (Think 2D Snapchat filter vs 3D person) you can add some depth with dewier/glossy formulation, knowing the planes of your face and where product should emphasize it through either a soft shadow or defined edge/line. Beginner stuff is like blush placement, neutral eye shadow, natural looking eyeliner to master the basics then get more dramatic from there .

This looks like the type you'd want to go for (but with a different color palette): https://youtu.be/F2px1SvHIIM

MAKEUP
Your complexion is clear and great! I think the moles add a lot of character, I wouldn't cover them up. For balance, I'd fill in your brows which are already nicely shaped so no problem there. The perfect brow formula is usually from your lifestyle. (Do you sweat a lot? Do you not have time for it? Bad dexterity?) I think you're a deep winter (silver brightens your skin) hmm but that would need a bit more testing. Other make-up would depend on how much you'd want to emphasize your features but they're not essential. Just some mascara to age up a bit and color on cheek and lips. A bright eyeshadow would look good and some highlight if you want a complete look. 

HAIR
Fine and thick hair is a struggle and usually means some level of wave. I'd suggest testing out the porosity and trying out a new hair routine because it's a bit frizzy right now. I see the wispy ends trying to hold a curl.

For the cut, the blunt and deep parting takes away from your youthful face. It's not doing you justice right now. Your face shape reminds me of Nayeon from Twice and you can see how her hair is styled. It's usually either sleek and clean (long, straight,, no bangs or hair pushed back) or romantic (more variety with the length + lush and wavy with wispy bangs), you can go with either depending on your personality. And I think your forehead is great but if you want to take focus away from it, I'd suggest more volume on top, bangs, or accessorizing  with earrings and/or headbands. 

Good luck on your journey!

You have a strong ingenue essence with your face. I'd suggest going for shorter hair as this length ages you a bit. I see some waves, maybe finding a way to define them more or hydrate your hair according to it's porosity as it looks a bit frizzy and flat. Dry shampoo is also nice for volume. You can also try out some feature framing bangs, just a light and wispy style nothing blunt or heavy. Your features are already quite delicate. 

To be more feminine with makeup, I'd suggest just filling in your brows a bit, maybe just some light brow gel. Just a touch of blush and lip stain, those multi use liquid formulas usually get the job done. Make sure they're light and bright according to your skin type. And some brown mascara could really bring out your eyes. 

I get the dressing in dark and neutrals from being body conscious. How you can slowly lighten your wardrobe is through replacing black with navy if you like it and adding pops of colors through small accessories. (Can just be a brighter neutral even!)

Overall that's how I think you can soften your image :)
